verdict.rationale: Pulumi Policies is a first-party policy-as-code feature: guardrails are defined in code and applied consistently across resources. Policy violations surface in pull request comments and checks, which gates changes before they are deployed. missing for 10: explicit documentation that violations block a preview/update (enforcement levels, mandatory vs advisory), detail on how policies run during `pulumi preview`/`up`, independent or hands-on corroboration of blocking behavior.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce policy-as-code checks that block non-compliant infrastructure changes before apply

citations.quote: Pulumi Policies enables you to implement policy as code across your entire cloud infrastructure.
You define guardrails in code and apply them consistently across resources managed by Pulumi IaC
Policy violations now appear in pull request comments and checks
